title: From Hamilton Māori Village & Waitomo Caves Tour Lunch
includes: Entry tickets to Waitomo Caves and Whakarewarewa Living Maori Village
Complimentary pick up and drop off from our Hamilton - Meeting Point
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the rich Māori culture and stunning natural wonders on this day tour from Hamilton. Begin at Whakarewarewa Village, where local guides share insights into Māori customs, traditions, and their deep connection to the land. Explore geothermal features like bubbling mud pools and geysers while enjoying a live cultural performance, including the famous haka dance. Then, journey to the enchanting Waitomo Caves, where thousands of glowworms create a magical atmosphere as you glide through the caves on a boat. A picnic lunch is included, making this an unforgettable day of cultural immersion and natural beauty.

- Full-day tour lasting 9 hours from Hamilton to Rotorua and Waitomo
- Guided exploration of Whakarewarewa Village with local insights
- Entry tickets included for both the Māori Village and Waitomo Caves
- Enjoy a picnic-style lunch amidst stunning natural landscapes
